author: Kusha N M
raw:
ದೇವನಿರುವನು ನಿನ್ನ ದೇಹದಲ್ಲಿಯೆ ಎಂದು
ಕಾವನವನೆಂದೆಂದು ಬೆಂಬಲಕೆ ನಿಂದು
ನೋವುಗಳ ಮರೆಸುತಲೆ ನಲಿವುಗಳ ತುಂಬುತಲಿ
ಈವನವ ಶಾಂತಿಯನು ಮೂಢಮನುಜ

lines: God dwells within your own body;
he protects you always, standing by your side;
making you forget your sorrows, filling you with joy,
he gives you peace, O deluded one.
en.bhavartha: The Divine is not far away; it lives within us and stands by us. Remembering this eases sorrow, brings joy, and gives peace.
